rule: Committed carrier of a supplied hb_epoch for an organization ledger whose head carries none. A push to main that lands it appends one organization ledger transition (ORGANIZATION_LEDGER_SUPPLIED_EPOCH) at this epoch, before the main-merge transfer. It is not an InTr hop: no address, no peer, no communication. When the head already carries a supplied epoch, nothing is appended.
